versions.content: Service name: ComM_GetCurrentComMode Syntax: Std_ReturnType ComM_GetCurrentComMode( ComM_UserHandleType User, ComM_ModeType* ComMode ) Service ID[hex]: 0x08 Sync/Async: Synchronous Reentrancy: Reentrant Parameters (in): User Handle of the user who requests a mode Parameters (inout): None Parameters (out): ComMode See ComM_ModeType Return value: Std_ReturnType E_OK: Successfully returned Communication Mode from Bus State Manager E_NOT_OK: Return of Communication Mode from Bus State Manager failed Description: Function to query the current Communication Mode. ComM shall use the corresponding interfaces of the Bus State Managers to get the current Communication Mode of the network. (Call to Bus State Manager API: XXXSM _GetCurrentComMode(...)) Available via : ComM.h
